title: Classic Baby Eyes
description: Makes baby mobs look cuter by adding an extra white pixel to their eyes, giving them a more expressive and adorable appearance while keeping the vanilla Minecraft style intact. 🥺✨
body:
Classic Baby Eyes 🥺

A small and simple Minecraft resource pack that makes baby mobs look even cuter! This pack adds one extra white pixel to the eyes of baby mobs, giving them a more expressive, adorable, and innocent appearance while keeping the original Minecraft style intact.

✨ Features:
Vanilla-friendly design
Very Subtle visual enhancement
Makes baby mobs look more expressive
Works with the default Minecraft aesthetic

Perfect for players who love small details and want their Minecraft world to feel a little more adorable without changing the game's classic look. 🐷🐺
